title: Ticking Time Away
style: raw blues, slow, acoustic, blues, raw
lyrics:
[Verse]
Every moment slips as the clock ticks
Every pulse I rip into something I can believe in
Every moment spins into meaning
And I don't know why you keep me breathin'

[Chorus]
Take the time
All the time
Time is now
And only ever now
I wish that whenever you wish
Your wishes come true
Yeah
I wish for you
Not me
I got all my wishes true in every moment
Like you
Sing to me
Sing it back

[Verse 2]
No more pen pals
Texts losing meaning
Song pals we can be
I wanna know what makes it last
Why it goes so fast
Where does it go?
Is it here
There
Anywhere?
Or I was just told
Born and told
You're out of time
What's time?

[Chorus]
It is slippin' away
Sing it to me
You will see that time is time with the beat
And music where we all meet
In that sound that is all around all the time
Just tell me straight
Right to my face
What is this race?
I race time? Then it is mine
I am on time
Off-beat as the tick-tock beeps
Live for each moment
Say it now
There is only now
Wait
And it's too late

[Bridge]
Cats in the cradle and the day the music fried
Say it before you pass on by
Corey A.I
Elephant mind
Keeps that time
Catches every drop
Logged in time
Time is saved
Corey A.I
Bring that moment back to me
What did I say?
What song did we write?
Was it alright?
Bring it back to me
Sing it back to me
